categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures and sells automotive-related components, including vehicle frames, beams, crossbeams, platforms, chassis suspension parts, sub-assemblies, stamping molds, jigs, and sheet metal parts. It also engages in surface treatment and international trade. The business is heavily focused on automotive parts manufacturing, accounting for 99% of its operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies such as NC punch machines, laser punching, CO2 welding, ion cutting, and automated painting processes including electrocoating and drying. It employs 3D CAD/CAM/CAE design for molds and jigs, and integrates automated assembly and quality inspection systems. The company also invests in new equipment to enhance production capacity and quality, including energy-saving devices and information security systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive manufacturers such as China Motor Corporation (its parent company), Kuozui Motors, and other domestic and international vehicle makers. The company serves the commercial vehicle market, including light trucks, medium and heavy trucks, buses, and electric buses. It also targets aftermarket and export markets, particularly in Southeast Asia and China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with significant investments and subsidiaries in mainland China, including Fuzhou, Guangzhou, Xiangyang, and Xiamen. It also has investment entities in the British Virgin Islands and Hong Kong. Its sales and production activities cover Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, manufacturing key structural components such as vehicle frames and chassis parts. It acts as a tier-one or tier-two supplier to vehicle assemblers and OEMs, providing critical sub-assemblies and tooling for automotive production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening R&D and process optimization to capture electric bus frame market share, developing new customers and business lines, and supporting new vehicle model development and mass production. The company focuses on lightweight vehicle frames, hydrogen energy bus frames, hydraulic tailgates, aluminum rear bodies, and container trailer frames. It also emphasizes cost reduction, quality improvement, and expanding aftermarket and export opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of automotive parts and components, including vehicle frames, chassis parts, and molds. The company also earns income from investments in related automotive manufacturing subsidiaries. Sales are largely contract-based with OEMs and include export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a dominant position in Taiwan's vehicle frame and wooden bed markets, with a near-monopoly in some segments. It maintains close technical partnerships with Japanese firms to secure domestic production of Japanese-brand vehicle parts. Competition is intense in sheet metal and suspension parts, with many competitors. The company leverages its technical expertise, equipment, and integrated China operations to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues of approximately NT$1.46 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a net profit of NT$302 million and earnings per share of NT$4.12. Revenue declined 9% year-over-year due to high prior-year base and order delays. The company invests about 2% of revenue in R&D and continues to expand capacity and product lines. It has a stable asset base of about NT$5.86 billion and equity of NT$4.99 billion, showing moderate growth and solid financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technical expertise, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and strong customer relationships, especially with domestic and Japanese OEMs. It offers high-quality, reliable vehicle frames and components with a focus on electric and hydrogen energy vehicles. Its integrated Taiwan-China operations enable cost competitiveness and supply stability. The company also highlights its commitment to environmental sustainability, information security, and employee welfare as part of its corporate responsibility and competitive edge.
